scenes.text: New game! Pay off America's forty trillion dollar debt.
You get one million dollars. Every. Single. Day.
Day one, one million. Day one hundred, a hundred million.
Keep going for your whole life. Eighty years.
Twenty-nine billion paid. Debt left? Still basically forty trillion.
You'd need about a hundred and nine thousand years.
The pyramids aren't even five thousand years old. Game over.

title: Paying Off the US Debt at $1 Million a Day
